title: 560. Random Point in Non-overlapping Rectangles

examples.explanation: Both [0,0] (first rectangle) and [3,3] (second rectangle) are valid answers.
The single-cell rectangle covers exactly one point.

hints: Adaptation: return any covered integer point; the judge only checks that it falls inside some rectangle.
The bottom-left corner of the first rectangle is always a valid answer.
A fully random solution would weight rectangles by their point counts, but determinism also passes here.
